title: Input with GUI
prompt:
Write a program that takes input from the user with a graphical user interface and prints out the results.
Sample Input: example
Sample Output: This is an example GUI application.
answer:
Sure, I can help you with that. Here's an example Python program that uses the Tkinter library to create a graphical user interface (GUI) for taking user input and printing the result. Make sure you have Tkinter installed on your system. You can install it using pip:

```bash
pip install tk
```

Here's the Python code:

```python
import tkinter as tk

def print_result():
    user_input = user_entry.get()
    output_label.config(text=f"This is a {user_input} GUI application.")

# Create the main window
root = tk.Tk()
root.title("User Input GUI")

# Create a label to display the result
output_label = tk.Label(root, text="Result will be displayed here.")
output_label.pack(padx=10, pady=10)

# Create an entry field for user input
user_entry = tk.Entry(root)
user_entry.pack(padx=10, pady=10)

# Create a button to print the result
print_button = tk.Button(root, text="Print Result", command=print_result)
print_button.pack(padx=10, pady=10)

# Start the main loop
root.mainloop()
```

When you run this program, it will display a window with an entry field and a button. When you enter some text in the entry field and click the button, the program will print the result in the label. You can customize the text in the `print_result()` function to display any message you want.
